attribution: Edges, kerbs and run-off traced from BD ORTHO 20 cm (IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0)
source: BD ORTHO 20 cm (WMS ORTHOIMAGERY.ORTHOPHOTOS.BDORTHO, EPSG:2154), resampled into road-aligned strips at 5 cm; PCRS 5 cm is not open for the Sarthe
frame: offsets in track-frame metres along the left normal of the track.json centreline: left > 0 is the distance to the left edge, right > 0 to the right edge (driving direction); width = left + right
edge_rule: inner edge of a kerb or of coloured paint; the outer edge of the painted edge line where asphalt continues more than 1.5 m beyond it (tarmac run-off, line_limited = 1); otherwise the asphalt / verge boundary. flag = 1: low confidence (< 0.4), interpolated between confident stations.
kerb_kinds: red_white: striped (raised / sawtooth) kerb, colour = its paint; flat: solid painted strip 0.5-2.6 m; sausage: yellow element <= 1.0 m wide. gap: m from the edge to the kerb's inner side.
runoff_doc: u0 / u1: metres outward from the kerb's outer edge (or from the edge without kerb), like trackside_layouts RUNOFF; ring: outline [x, z] in the track frame; capped: the surface runs past 40 m (tarmac) / 30 m (grass): a road, car park or field, not a run-off.
